method: install_read_tap on the damage table 0x565ed0..+0x334*4; fire one weapon per window; the hit appliers at i960 0xbe0f0/0xbe170 index table[type*16] where type is byte 0 of the projectile record (g1). Player mech base 0x503ad0 (projectile slot = base+0x200+i*0x20), opponent 0x5040d0.

left.evidence: player shot read with defender g2=0x5040d0 during the left-trigger window

right.evidence: player shot read with defender g2=0x5040d0 during the right-trigger window

center.evidence: Center is the held left+right chord (per the cabinet control). prob_ordnance_id.lua holding both continuously still only spawns the right projectile (record byte0=7), and prob_weapon_damage_type.lua never sees a third type on the mech hit applier while held. object+0x13a (the action-3 input) is also never written by the MAME `von` ports, so action 3 appears unreachable as a projectile from the exposed inputs; center is likely a melee/contact attack with a separate (non-table) damage path.

applied_damage.method: probe_weapon_damage.lua fires one weapon per window and logs the opponent working cell; clean drops partition the applied damage
applied_damage.note: A left hit moved the opponent working cell by exactly 100, equal to table record 1 (raw 100.0), so the applied scale is 1.0 at the tested range. Right (type 7, raw 175.0) and center were not connected in the run.

damage_scaling.model: applied = object+0x4a (raw table damage) * global(0x503ab4) * distance_factor / 10000, then optionally scaled by the profile percent (+0x63c when object+0x172==11, +0x640 when 0x172==14) / 100, then by a factor selected on 0x503ac0.
damage_scaling.status: path recovered but not yet reduced to a closed form; not wired into the kernel
